DataSource.query:
begin
select 
case when COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP in ('90','99') then  COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP else 'Others' end as code_grpt,
case when COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '90' then '90 - clients KCS / CH'
     when COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '99' then '99 - Kuhn Group'
	 else 
	 'Others' end as lib_grpt
from common.DIM_CUSTOMER_COGNOS
group by case when COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP in ('90','99') then  COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP else 'Others' end, 
case when COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '90' then '90 - clients KCS / CH'
     when COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '99' then '99 - Kuhn Group'
	 else 
	 'Others' end
end
